name: Перевод
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished desktop website SECTION concept for the existing Globoox landing for authors, naturally continuing its selected hero. This is one section design, not multiple alternatives and not an entire website. Flat, full-bleed website screenshot; no browser chrome, app-device frame, montage, option labels, header, hero, team, publisher claims or navigation. Target1536px wide; use the stated section-height naturally, without stretching typography or content.
Reference image1 is the SELECTED LIVE HERO: use its premium contemporary editorial art direction, Lora-like Cyrillic serif, Inter-like body, warm parchment #F4F0E8, dark forest #2C3B2D, terracotta #C05A3A, restrained sage/mist, hairline rules, generous calm spacing, subtle linen/paper materials. Ignore its small comparison label and do not repeat its hero. Subsequent reference images show CURRENT SECTION CONTENT and any retained interaction/illustration principle; redesign the layout coherently rather than copying their old appearance. Preserve the exact supplied Russian wording. No testimonials, statistics, promises, new features, forms, prices, badges, or invented paragraphs. No generic card grids, heavy shadows, gradients, glassmorphism or tech-network decoration. Prefer clear typographic hierarchy and fine dividers; realistic implementable web design with readable text. Do not add the removed footer mission, “КНИГИ БЕЗ ГРАНИЦ”, “Открыть приложение”, a standalone G monogram, contact email text, or a team block. Team is explicitly out of scope. The concepts are visual proposals only, no production changes.

TARGET SECTION: Перевод. Target image1536×820, natural full-width section.

ART DIRECTION:
Warm parchment editorial opening. Left about42%: large asymmetric serif headline, with “наш перевод” in restrained terracotta italic; one very thin vertical rule separates the right side. Right about50%: the exact body as comfortable22–24px paragraphs split only at existing sentences; no card. Under the right text, one low-relief physical paper detail: two subtly offset cream manuscript leaves, English/Russian typographic lines suggested at a very small decorative scale, with delicate proofreader marks and a short terracotta thread connecting them. It must feel like careful literary craft, not a robot or AI dashboard. The decorative paper is secondary to readable content; no invented visible body text or repeated headline. Asymmetric but balanced, related to hero04’s editorial grid. Keep enough bottom breathing room to meet the next green section.

EXACT CONTENT:
Ключ к зарубежным читателям: наш перевод

В его основе наша собственная технология на базе искусственного интеллекта, созданная совместно с лингвистами для художественной и научно-популярной литературы. Авторский стиль, интонация и терминология бережно сохраняются, а по качеству перевод сопоставим с работой профессионального переводчика.

review.copy: Main Russian heading and explanation retained; decorative narrative removed, chapter labels remain.
review.composition: Editorial split, fine rule, restrained paper craft; team absent.

correction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Edit this exact translation-section design. Change ONLY the invented narrative paragraphs printed on the two lower-right decorative manuscript sheets: remove those paragraph words and replace them with fine, neutral grey typesetting rules of comparable density, so they read as an abstract manuscript illustration, not a second real text sample. Keep the small headings 'Chapter I' and 'Глава I', the restrained terracotta proofreader marks and connecting thread. Preserve the entire main Russian headline and full upper-right Russian explanation verbatim; keep their layout, fonts, colors, spacing, vertical divider, paper positions/material/shadows, overall image dimensions and all other pixels as closely as possible. Do not introduce any additional words, UI, people, books or logos. The only text content change is removing the invented story from the decorative paper sheets.
correction.reason: Initial illustration contained invented story paragraphs; replace with abstract typesetting rules.
